stories.title: SpaceX closes its acquisition of AI coding startup Cursor
stories.summary: SpaceX has officially completed its acquisition of Cursor, the AI-powered coding assistant startup, according to TechCrunch and Engadget. The close formalizes a deal that brings a leading AI developer-tools company under the umbrella of Elon Musk's rocket and satellite firm. Neither outlet's reporting details deal terms or how Cursor's product and team will be integrated going forward.
stories.whyItMatters: A rocket and satellite company absorbing a top AI coding tool shows how quickly AI-assisted software development is spreading beyond pure software firms and into industrial and aerospace companies.
whatToWatch: Whether Cursor keeps operating as a standalone product for outside customers
How SpaceX plans to deploy Cursor across its own engineering teams
Any leadership or team changes at Cursor following the close
questions: What did SpaceX pay for Cursor?
Will Cursor's existing customers outside SpaceX retain access to the tool?

stories.title: Stripe and Advent reportedly in advanced talks to acquire PayPal
stories.summary: Stripe is reportedly in talks, alongside private equity firm Advent, to buy PayPal, according to TechCrunch and Engadget. Both outlets describe negotiations as heating up, though neither Stripe nor PayPal has publicly confirmed a deal.
stories.whyItMatters: A Stripe acquisition of PayPal would be one of the largest consolidations in online payments history, reshaping competition across checkout and fintech infrastructure.
